description: Converts an ordered list of IPageBlock objects into a self-contained HTML document. Each block type maps to an appropriate element with embedded Notion-style CSS. A BlockType.Table block is rendered from its child TableRow blocks into <table><thead>/<tbody>, and each cell carries the column's alignment as an inline text-align style when TableBlockContent.ColumnAlignments declares one. Legacy consecutive TableRow blocks without a parent Table block are still exported correctly.

examples.title: Export page blocks to HTML
examples.code:
var blocks = await BlockProvider.GetBlocksAsync(pageId.ToString());
var html   = NotionHtmlExporter.Export(blocks, pageTitle: page.Title);
